title: Organic Cutout
description: Un style graphique minimaliste à fort contraste, caractérisé par des silhouettes pleines et ondulantes. Rappelant les papiers découpés du milieu du siècle, il repose sur des aplats de couleurs et un jeu audacieux d'espace positif/négatif sans aucun ombrage ni détail interne.
description_en: A minimalist, high-contrast graphic style featuring solid, undulating silhouettes. Reminiscent of mid-century paper cut-outs, it relies entirely on flat colors and bold positive/negative space interplay without any shading or internal details.
description_fr: Un style graphique minimaliste à fort contraste, caractérisé par des silhouettes pleines et ondulantes. Rappelant les papiers découpés du milieu du siècle, il repose sur des aplats de couleurs et un jeu audacieux d'espace positif/négatif sans aucun ombrage ni détail interne.
prompt: Minimalist flat vector graphic, organic paper cut-out style illustration. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Render the scene entirely as solid, flat silhouettes primarily using striking {{primary_color}}. Strip away all internal lines, intricate textures, shading, gradients, highlights, and volumetric lighting. The visual identity relies purely on the sharp, undulating, organic outer contours of the subjects, creating a bold, graphic interplay of positive and negative space. Place these stark, unshaded forms directly against a completely flat, unvarying {{secondary_color}} background. Introduce {{accent_color}} only as stark, isolated graphic punches if required for separation, but maintain strict adherence to the flat silhouette aesthetic. The edge treatment must feel slightly hand-drawn or scissor-cut—smooth but featuring natural, irregular curves rather than rigid, mathematically perfect geometric lines. Emphasize extreme high contrast, absolute 2D flatness, and stark graphic simplicity. Every element must read clearly through its outer shape alone, echoing mid-century modern graphic design and bold abstract expressionist cut-outs. The material quality should evoke smooth matte digital ink or perfectly flat construction paper, completely devoid of grain, noise, or halftone patterns. Ensure the spatial dynamics remain strictly two-dimensional, utilizing overlapping flat shapes rather than linear perspective to imply any necessary depth. The emotional register is bold, striking, and aggressively modern. flat vector, minimalist silhouette, solid fill, paper cut-out, high contrast, organic contours, 2d graphic, no shading, abstract shapes, mid-century graphic, bold contours, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

background_prompt: A pure, minimalist background environment composed of flat, abstract organic shapes and undulating color blocks. Rendered without any gradients, shading, or internal lines, the scene uses solid expanses of {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}} to create a stark, two-dimensional landscape or spatial arrangement. The edges of all forms are sharp yet organically curved, resembling smooth paper cut-outs, establishing a bold interplay of positive and negative space devoid of any specific subjects or focal points.
background_prompt_removebg: A pure, minimalist background environment composed of flat, abstract organic shapes and undulating color blocks using {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}. Rendered without gradients or shading, the scene introduces an organic, undulating foreground border framing the invisible subject in {{accent_color}}. These flat, scissor-cut elements create a stark, two-dimensional spatial arrangement that transitions seamlessly into and interacts directly with the flat {{background_color}} surface, maintaining absolute graphic simplicity.

video.motion: Elements morph and slide with fluid, organic elasticity, maintaining strict 2D flatness while positive and negative spaces dynamically shift and rescale.
video.camera: Locked, static orthographic framing with zero perspective shifts.
video.temporal_texture: Edges maintain a sharp, solid, non-flickering contour, with colors remaining absolutely flat and unshaded throughout the animation.
video.avoid: 3D rotation, lighting changes, shadows, gradients, motion blur, and internal line drawing.
